description:
City Signal is a new 3-part series brought to you by NTS & DistroKid - Deep diving into scenes and sounds coming from a particular city through the lens of its key players.
Kicking things off in Berlin, throughout September we'll broadcast episodes hosted by Yazzus (6th Sep), Urin (13th Sep) and a Special Guest TBA (20th Sep)
